title: Wild Arctic Summer
description: Time-lapse imagery from July 9 to Sept. 13 2012 shows an ice island calve from Petermann Glacier and pass through Nares Strait.
keywords: PD NASA, Petermann Glacier, Geomorphology of Greenland, Glaciology of Greenland, NASA videos in 2012, Ice islands, Videos by NASA

transcript.text: July 16, 2012. The Peterman Glacier in northwest Greenland lost a massive iceberg for the second
time in three years. As the ice floating and the fjord broke up, the ice island was carried
by the currents down the glaciers outlet channel and toward the NARA's Strait. Known as Peterman
Ice Island 2012, it was about 12 square miles, half the size of Manhattan, and floating at
one kilometer per day. NASA's Aqua and Terra satellites made multiple passes each day over
the polar regions, allowing scientists to track the ice island, whenever clouds didn't block
